_note: Manager colours. Assigned in order to the managers in teams.json, so a manager keeps their colour wherever they appear. Edit freely -- add, reorder or replace. If there are more managers than colours the list wraps, and two managers will share.
_chosen: Picked by maximising the smallest separation between any two colours, measured in OKLab under normal vision and simulated protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia (see tools/check_palette.py). This set of 16 separates better than a typical 8-colour palette does: worst all-pairs distance 9.1 normal / 4.7 worst-case colour-blind on light, 8.0 / 5.7 on dark. If you swap colours in, re-run the checker.
